hints.title: The Delta Observation
hints.text: Suppose you know ans[u] (the sum of distances when u is the root). If you shift the root across edge (u, v) to v: What happens to the distances? Every node in v's subtree gets 1 step CLOSER to the root! Every other node (N - count[v]) gets 1 step FURTHER!

hints.title: The Formula
hints.text: ans[v] = ans[u] - count[v] + (N - count[v]) = ans[u] + N - 2 * count[v]. Where count[v] is the number of nodes in v's subtree when rooted at 0.

hints.title: The 2-Pass Strategy
hints.text: Pass 1 (Post-order / Bottom-Up): Root the tree arbitrarily at node 0. Compute count[i] for every subtree and ans[0] (distances from node 0). Pass 2 (Pre-order / Top-Down): Traverse down from node 0 and propagate ans[v] using the formula.

hints.title: Code Skeleton

complexity.notes: Two-pass tree rerooting: bottom-up subtree counts, top-down distance transfer.
